title: Pure From the Underworld
summary: Pure From the Underworld fiendish combo and control build, uniting Tour Guide From the Underworld and her infernal tour bus entourage with iconic passenger Fiends. The deck utilizes Tour Guide's instant Level 3 recruitment to link climb through Beat Cop and Muckraker into Underworld Goddess of the Closed World, while looping Dark Necrofear and graveyard disruption.

summary.title: Starters
points: Tour Guide From the Underworld summons any Level 3 Fiend monster directly from your hand or Deck on Normal Summon, providing instant 2-body material for Link-2 or Rank 3 plays.
Sangan searches any monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck when sent from the field to the GY (such as handtraps or Tour Guide for next turn).
Fiendish Rhino Warrior protects other Fiends from destruction and sends any Fiend (such as Scarm or Tour Bus From the Underworld) from Deck to GY when sent to the GY.
Scarm, Malebranche of the Burning Abyss searches Tour Guide From the Underworld during the End Phase of the turn it was sent to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Tour Guide From the Underworld
steps: Normal Summon Tour Guide From the Underworld, activating its on-summon effect to Special Summon Fiendish Rhino Warrior (or Sangan) from your Deck.
Link Summon Muckraker From the Underworld using Tour Guide and Fiendish Rhino Warrior.
Trigger Fiendish Rhino Warrior in the GY to send Scarm, Malebranche of the Burning Abyss from your Deck to the GY.
Discard 1 card to activate Muckraker's Ignition effect, Special Summoning Fiendish Rhino Warrior (or Tour Guide) back from the GY.
End Phase: Scarm triggers in the GY to add a second Tour Guide From the Underworld from your Deck to your hand for follow-up next turn.

summary.title: The Underworld Link Bosses
points: Muckraker From the Underworld can tribute 1 of your Fiends instead of any card you control being destroyed, and revives any Fiend from the GY by discarding 1 card (locking you to Fiend Special Summons for the turn).

Beat Cop from the Underworld tributes 1 monster to place a Patrol Counter on a face-up card, protecting it from battle or effect destruction while triggering GY floaters like Sangan or Doomdog Octhros.

Underworld Goddess of the Closed World is the ultimate Link-5 boss: it uses 1 opponent face-up monster as Link Material, negates all opponent face-up monsters on summon, and negates any effect that would Special Summon from the GY as a Quick Effect.

summary.title: Dark Necrofear Package
points: Doomdog Octhros searches a Level 8 Fiend (Dark Necrofear or Dark Spirit of Banishment) when sent from the field to the GY.
Dark Necrofear Special Summons itself by banishing 3 Fiends from your GY, and equips to an opponent monster to take permanent control of it when destroyed by their card.
Dark Spirit of Banishment sends itself from hand or field to the GY when the opponent attacks or activates an effect to revive Dark Necrofear from your GY.
Tour Bus From the Underworld targets a monster in either GY when sent to the GY and shuffles it into the Deck, recycling your Link bosses or disrupting opposing GY lines.

summary.title: Extra Deck Engines
points: Dante, Traveler of the Burning Abyss mills up to 3 cards for cost as an alternative Rank 3 play, loading the GY with Fiend triggers.
Unchained Soul Lord of Yama and Goblin Biker Big Gabonga offer supplementary Link and Xyz extension off leftover Level 3 bodies.
The Phantom Knights of Rusty Bardiche provides Link-3 board disruption when climbing with DARK monsters.
